connector.name: Data-grounded sprint retro
connector.registryDescription: Data-grounded sprint retrospectives from your Jira, GitHub, and Slack activity.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package retro-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sathvic-kollu account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
env.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net. Required for a live retro.

env.name: JIRA_EMAIL
env.description: Atlassian account email the API token belongs to.

env.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
env.description: Jira API token from id.atlassian.com. Read-only use.

env.name: JIRA_BOARD_ID
env.description: Optional board id to pin when the account has several boards.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional GitHub read-only token for PR review latency and reverts.

env.name: GITHUB_REPOS
env.description: Optional comma-separated owner/name repos to scope PR analysis.

env.name: SLACK_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Slack read token to scan sprint channels for blocker and incident language.

env.name: SLACK_CHANNELS
env.description: Optional comma-separated Slack channel ids to scan for the sprint window.

env.name: RETRO_DEMO_MODE
env.description: Set to true to force the synthetic demo sprint even when credentials are present.
